tests.name: Gazebo headless launch, /clock and four sensor topics
ROS command equals Gazebo command and moves body
IMU bridge typo fails route test and live echo; correction passes
MCAP has seven nonempty topics for 44.395 s of simulation time

defect.reproducer: In pr07-defect commit e7a588d33ffcce901ca0dee15c3b9d2f45072dd3, IMU gz_topic_name=/vehicle/imu_typo. The route test failed and ros2 topic echo /vehicle/imu --once timed out after 3 s despite one ROS publisher; Gazebo /vehicle/imu still emitted messages.
defect.root_cause: The bridge subscribed to a nonexistent Gazebo topic; the existence of its ROS publisher did not establish message delivery.
defect.proof_after: After stopping the defect launch and switching to pr07, the same route test passed, one bridge launched, and ros2 topic echo /vehicle/imu --once received an imu_link header.

runtime_note: Ubuntu 26.04.1, ROS 2 Lyrical, Gazebo Jetty 10.5.0, ROS_DOMAIN_ID=107. ackermann_msgs and related ROS type support were installed/updated before the live test. Mesa llvmpipe rendered the headless sensors.
